description:
Manage immutable JSON behavior tree definitions with SHA-256 hash verification (actions: register, list, get, synthesize). Use manage_behaviors instead of load_behavior when defining, versioning, or synthesizing behavior tree structures rather than executing them.

Returns tree definition, version metadata, SHA-256 content hash, or synthesis DAG.

action.description: Behavior definition management operation: register, list, get, synthesize

steps.description: Steps or actions to synthesize into a behavior tree

strategy.description: Root composition strategy for synthesize action (default: sequence)

name: manage_behaviors
